fields.attempt_RAW.seconds: Per native attempt: includes reset/resident/benchmark and ledger extraction; excludes later receipt writes and final worker cleanup.
fields.baseline_RESULT.seconds: Whole baseline worker timer before final cleanup. Overlaps attempt_RAW seconds.
fields.CASE_LIFECYCLE.seconds: Baseline worker timer through final cleanup. Overlaps both other native timers.

fields.RAW.seconds: Actor timer through environment/resident/vision-close and ledger extraction. Excludes prior import/runtime construction, service cold loads, queue waits and controller launch overhead.
fields.RESULT.seconds: Same scalar copied from RAW; never added again.

fields.SERVICE_RESULT.seconds: Vision process including model loading, RPC wait and cleanup; overlaps actor time.

warnings: Unknown/partial conditions are never inserted as physical failures.
Only complete SHA/pairing-verified CONDITION_RESULT rows enter success/net counts.
Costs from a closed subset are not whole-cohort costs or a whole-cohort efficiency rate.
Both arms have no Qwen mechanism; zero Qwen tokens is not a demonstrated saving.
